candidateDecisions.label: Accounting, finance & economics for business decisions
Business resilience & leadership of societal transitions

analysis: The broad option combines venture and product design, marketing, accounting, finance, legal context, strategy and organizational behavior. Sustainability governance supplies specific policy and stakeholder context for business decisions in place of the early-only delta project. The finance option retains accounting, money and banking, economics, behavioral economics and econometrics, with statistics, data science and machine learning; Python provides a stronger methods foundation than the broad business AI overview. The transition option combines business foundations and product design with circular operations, sustainable farming and energy, environmental justice, negotiation, climate communication and policy. Resource recovery and material design supply technical understanding of circular production, while the policy course supports regulatory and implementation decisions. Marketing and consumer study are already substantial in the broad option; a fourth marketing and supply-chain plan would largely repeat it. Life-cycle and circular operations evidence cannot substitute for the comparator’s dedicated supply-chain logistics and resilience sequence. Organizational psychology and leadership cover motivation and people management in part, while consulting, dedicated HRM and sustainable finance remain visible gaps. Optional UCR independent research is separate from scheduled credit.
